title: release-approval/v0 event
description: DRAFT (draft_revision 1) -- NOT FROZEN. One append-only ledger event of the ONLY promotion authority in the Evidence-Closed Delivery Authority DAG: a human (or an authorized emergency principal, break_glass_approve) binding exact digests -- receipt, its own semantic content, the release bundle, the selection manifest, and the target -- to an approval/rejection/revocation. No kind is exempt from this exact binding (R14); no verdict in promotion-receipt/v0 can substitute for it, and human_release_approval never appears as a predicate there. See docs/protocols/release-approval-v0.md.

event_id.description: R18: recomputed by the verifier as sha256(JCS(event without event_id)) -- same event_id convention as release-evidence/v0. A declared value that does not match is rejected; a duplicate event_id within one ledger fixture is rejected.

receipt_digest.description: R19: the JCS sha256 of the WHOLE promotion-receipt object this event approves/rejects/revokes/bypasses. Checked, in a composite ledger fixture, against the real receipt included in that fixture -- a value that resolves to no receipt in the fixture is rejected (TEST-06).

receipt_semantic_digest.description: The receipt's own semantic_digest (R12) at approval time -- carried separately from receipt_digest because TOCTOU compares semantic content (time-excluded), not the whole-object digest.

bundle_digest.description: R19: must equal the referenced receipt's own subject.bundle_digest. A different value is a stale approval binding (TEST-05) -- e.g. the bundle was replaced by a new attempt after this approval's receipt was evaluated.

subject.description: R14: every kind carries this same exact-binding subject shape -- no kind is exempt, including break_glass_approve (R16).

principal_id.description: R17: pseudonymous by construction -- the pattern rejects '@' and whitespace at the schema level, so an email address or a free-text human name cannot be written here even before the personal-dimension scan runs.

expires_at.description: R15: required on approval_granted and break_glass_approve (schema-enforced below), forbidden otherwise.

revoked_approval_event_id.description: approval_revoked only (schema-enforced below): the exact event_id being revoked.

bypassed_predicate_ids.description: break_glass_approve only (schema-enforced below): a non-empty, duplicate-free subset of promotion-receipt/v0's own predicate_id closed set -- the exact predicates this emergency approval bypasses. Never human_release_approval (not a member of that set at all). A composite ledger fixture additionally requires every id here to actually appear among the referenced receipt's own predicates[] -- bypassing a predicate the receipt never evaluated is meaningless (checked by verify-fixtures.mjs, not expressible in this single-event schema).

recorded_after_side_effect.description: break_glass_approve only, optional: true when the ledger append happened after the promotion side effect already occurred (ledger unavailable at the time) -- the event stays honestly marked rather than backdated.
